{{short description|American college basketball season}} {{Use American English|date=March 2026}} {{Use mdy dates|date=August 2023}} {{Infobox college sports team season |year=2020–21 |team=Iowa State Cyclones |sport=Basketball |image=Iowa State Cyclones logo.svg |conference=Big 12 Conference |short_conf=Big 12 |record=2–22 |conf_record=0–18 |head_coach=[[Steve Prohm]] |hc_year=6th |stadium=[[Hilton Coliseum]] |champion= |tourney= |tourney_result= }} {{2020–21 Big 12 men's basketball standings}} The '''2020–21 Iowa State Cyclones men's basketball team''' represented [[Iowa State University]] during the [[2020–21 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The Cyclones were led by [[Steve Prohm]], who coached his sixth and final season at Iowa State.{{Cite web|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/story/_/id/31072975/steve-prohm-iowa-state-cyclones-men-basketball-coach|title=Prohm out following 2-22 season at Iowa State|date=16 March 2021}} They played their home games at [[Hilton Coliseum]] in [[Ames, Iowa]] as members of the [[Big 12 Conference]]. The Cyclones would suffer through a [[COVID-19]]-plagued 2–22 record, including an 0–18 mark in Big 12 play, the first team to go winless through the Big 12 since [[2013–14 TCU Horned Frogs men's basketball team|TCU in 2014]]. They lost in the First round of the [[2021 Big 12 men's basketball tournament|Big 12 tournament]] to [[2020–21 Oklahoma Sooners men's basketball team|Oklahoma]]. Following the end of the season, ISU athletic director [[Jamie Pollard]] announced that the school and Prohm had parted ways.{{Cite web|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/story/_/id/31072975/steve-prohm-iowa-state-cyclones-men-basketball-coach|title=Prohm out following 2-22 season at Iowa State|date=16 March 2021}} ==Previous season== The [[2018–19 Iowa State Cyclones men's basketball team|Cyclones]] finished the [[2019–20 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2019–20 season]] 12–20, 5–13 in Big 12 play to finish in ninth place. They lost to [[2018–19 Oklahoma State Cowboys basketball team|Oklahoma State]] in the first round of the [[2020 Big 12 men's basketball tournament|Big 12 Conference tournament]]. They were one of the few major conference teams in the country to complete a full season before play was halted nationally due to the [[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States|COVID-19 pandemic]]. ==Offseason== ===Departures=== {| class="wikitable" style="text-align: center" |+ style="{{CollegePrimaryStyle|Iowa State Cyclones|border=0|color=white}}" |Offseason Departures {{CollegeSecondaryHeader|team=Iowa State Cyclones|Name|Position|Reason}} |- |Zion Griffin |Forward |Transferred to [[UIC Flames men's basketball|UIC]]{{Cite web|title=Flames Add Three to Men's Basketball Roster|url=https://uicflames.com/news/2020/4/15/flames-add-three-to-mens-basketball-roster.aspx|access-date=2020-07-01|website=UIC Athletics}} |- |[[Caleb Grill]] |Guard |Transferred to [[UNLV Runnin' Rebels basketball|UNLV]]{{Cite web|date=2020-04-06|title=Guard Caleb Grill transfers from Iowa State to UNLV|url=https://www.reviewjournal.com/sports/unlv/unlv-basketball/guard-caleb-grill-transfers-from-iowa-state-to-unlv-2000023/|access-date=2020-07-01|website=Las Vegas Review-Journal}} |- |Prentiss Nixon |Guard |Graduated |- |[[Michael Jacobson (athlete)|Michael Jacobson]] |Forward |Graduated |- |[[Tyrese Haliburton]] |Guard |Declared for the [[2020 NBA draft]];
